# What `pnpm verify` runs

> **In plain words.** One command checks everything before a push. It runs the gates below in order and prints one line per gate; the first gate that fails prints its whole output and stops the run. The quick gates come first (they need no dependencies and take a second); then the formatter, the linter, the type check, the kit's manifest check on the modules' test Worker configurations, and the two test suites. Both modules are checked against the kit's packed packages in kit/, the same files a client repository installs (R-02).

| Order | Gate | Command | What it refuses |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | agents | `node scripts/check-agents.mjs` | ai.md over budget; a kit rule or mail law without exactly one line in ai.md; a pointer file that differs from its template; a copied fact (a count next to table, migration, route or binding, a UUID shape, a hostname) in an instruction file |
| 2 | tokens | `node scripts/check-tokens.mjs` | a secret name used in a workflow or a `wrangler secret put` command without a row in the token registry; a row with a missing field, an unknown status or a duplicate name |
| 3 | identifiers | `node scripts/check-identifiers.mjs` | a name of the first client's existing platform or repositories anywhere in the repository; a UUID shape, a long hex identifier or an email address |
| 4 | deps | `node scripts/check-deps.mjs` | a dependency without a row in the dependency registry, one not pinned once in the catalog, a package.json carrying its own version, a registered row nothing uses; a kit package with no packed file in kit/ or at another version |
| 5 | docs | `node scripts/check-docs.mjs` | a generated document that differs from its source; a document under docs/ missing from the index or without front matter; a document over its size budget; a relative link that points nowhere |
| 6 | format | `pnpm exec prettier --check .` | a code file not formatted by Prettier (run pnpm format) |
| 7 | lint | `pnpm exec eslint .` | an ESLint finding |
| 8 | typecheck | `pnpm -r run typecheck` | a type error in either module, its Worker code against the Workers runtime and its pages against the DOM, with the kit's packed packages as they are in kit/ |
| 9 | manifest | `pnpm exec oltrem manifest check modules/email modules/campaigns modules/mail` | a binding, queue, class, cron, var or secret in a module's test Worker configuration that its oltrem.manifest.json does not list, one over its cap, or an env.NAME use the manifest does not list (R-09); run by the kit's own command-line tool, from kit/ |
| 10 | tests | `node --test scripts/**/*.test.mjs` | a failing test of the verify chain and the packing scripts (Node's built-in runner, every *.test.mjs file under scripts/) |
| 11 | modules | `pnpm exec vitest run` | a failing module test; every module is tested inside the Workers runtime with the bindings their wrangler configuration declares, against the kit's packed packages in kit/ |

A gate is never skipped, weakened or bypassed to get green (R-02): the cause is fixed. A new gate is a new entry in `scripts/lib/gates.mjs`, a test, and this page regenerated with `pnpm docs:build`.
